title: The Truth of the Artifact Spirit
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji personally defeated Han Lie, but before death Han Lie shouted 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao will not forgive you.' From the depths of the ruins, a whisper from the Eye of Heavenly Dao suddenly echoed, as the chess game of fate accelerates toward its final move.

text.content: That voice sealed for ten thousand years was not words, but a pure divine consciousness, crashing into the Mental Sea of all present like monstrous waves. Everyone felt their vision darken, as if their very souls were branded with something. Only the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms suddenly burned scalding hot, emanating a ghostly blue glow, as if responding to this long-awaited summons.

The cracks on the stone statue's surface had spread across its entire body, fragments of stone cascading down, revealing within a crystal-clear jade-white skeleton. That skeleton sat cross-legged with both hands forming seals, and above its chest hovered a fist-sized cluster of ghostly blue flame—this was the artifact spirit's true form, sealed for ten thousand years, slowly opening a pair of eyes brimming with vicissitudes.

dialogue.content: Descendant of the Chen family... you have finally arrived.

text.content: The artifact spirit's voice was like an ancient well without waves, yet carried an overwhelming pressure that suffocated. Chen Ji felt the spiritual energy around him imprisoned by invisible shackles, making even breathing difficult. He stared intently at that ghostly blue flame, his pupils contracting—the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms trembled even more violently, as if reunited with a long-lost kin.

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record was never granted by the Heavenly Dao, but created by your ancestor Chen Xuan. Ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan refined this record using the Great Karma Technique, intending to use it against the Eye of Heavenly Dao that was about to awaken. However, the Eye of Heavenly Dao was cunning beyond measure—when the Tianji Record was on the verge of completion, it was corrupted, turning it into a tool for selecting chess pieces.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his mind explode, countless thoughts surging like a tide. He had long known the Tianji Record had an extraordinary origin, but never imagined it was his ancestor's weapon against the Heavenly Dao. What chilled his heart even more was that the foresight ability he depended on was actually a deliberately implanted flawed function—every use consumed his already scarce Heavenly Fate.

dialogue.content: And you, from the moment of your birth, were selected by the Eye of Heavenly Dao as a chess piece. Your fate, your opportunities, everyone you encounter, were all part of its chess game. Every prophecy from the Tianji Record was it using your eyes to peer upon the world.

text.content: However, the artifact spirit turned its words, and a hint of pity flickered in those vicissitudinous eyes. However precise the chess game, there is a way to break the pattern. If you can find three things—the Lock Key of Fate, the Heart of Heavenly Fate, and the Seed of Karma—you can sever the karmic bond with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, and then the Tianji Record will restore to the complete form when Chen Xuan created it.

As Chen Ji was about to press for more details, a dazzling blood-red radiance suddenly erupted from the depths of the ruins. An aura so familiar it made his heart tremble spread through the air—it was the unique resonance of Chen family bloodline! His sister Chen Nian had triggered some ten-thousand-year-old inheritance sealed within these ruins!

choice.prompt: Faced with this cruel truth that subverted all cognition, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Suppress the anger, analyze this ten-thousand-year chess game with a strategist's calm, secretly seeking a method to break the pattern.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain further guidance from the artifact spirit

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully pressing down the surging fury. Anger is the indulgence of the weak; a strategist never seeks momentary satisfaction. He slowly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'Where is the Lock Key of Fate?'

A hint of approval flickered in the artifact spirit's eyes: 'You are more patient than Chen Xuan was in his time. The Lock Key of Fate... is right by your side.' Chen Ji's heart tightened, instinctively looking toward that blood-red radiance deep in the ruins—Chen Nian!

choices.text: Seething with rage, questioning the artifact spirit
choices.description: Why was he born a chess piece? Why can the Eye of Heavenly Dao arbitrarily manipulate others' fates? He would demand an explanation from this unjust heaven and earth.
choices.visible_cost: May激怒 artifact spirit, lose guidance
choices.visible_reward: Release suppressed emotions, show a strong heart

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly clenched his fist, the spiritual energy around him surging violently, even forcing back the artifact spirit's ghostly blue flame by three fen. He said word by word: 'When did my, Chen Ji's, life ever become something for your Heavenly Dao to control?'

The artifact spirit was not angry at all; instead, it let out a low laugh: 'Good! The Chen family bloodline should possess such pride. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's choice of you may indeed be its greatest mistake in ten thousand years.'

choices.description: Neither accept nor resist, hide true thoughts before the artifact spirit, secretly layout waiting for the opportunity to break the pattern.
choices.visible_reward: Let the Eye of Heavenly Dao lower its guard
choices.risk_hint: The artifact spirit may see through

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, concealing all the surging killing intent and unwillingness in his gaze. He slightly bowed, his tone respectful: 'The junior is grateful for the teaching. May I ask the artifact spirit master, where are the Heart of Heavenly Fate and the Seed of Karma?'

The artifact spirit fell silent for a moment, a deeper meaning flickering in those vicissitudinous eyes: 'You hide very deeply, more like an unsheathed sword than Chen Xuan was. But remember—even the sharpest sword needs sharpening.'

In the depths of the ruins, the blood-red radiance grew increasingly brilliant. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—that was the Chen family bloodline calling to its kin. Chen Nian must be at a critical moment of some kind of awakening—and he was unable to see any prophetic images about her, the essence of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key fully exposed.

Just then, a furious roar like thunder crashing rang out from the direction of the ruins entrance. A figure wrapped entirely in black lightning broke through the wall, and wherever it passed, the ground cracked and spiritual energy went mad—Han Lie, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, burst into the ruins' core with a livid face.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! I never expected a waste like you would dare sneak into the forbidden grounds alone! Today is your death!

text.content: Han Lie's aura was like a mountain pressing down, his sect's supreme technique 'Xuanming True Art' fully activated, a black Black Tortoise phantom faintly visible behind him. In his hand he gripped a long halberd entirely pitch-black, thunder light coiling around the halberd blade—this was the Xuanwu Sect's secret treasure 'Sky-Splitting Halberd'.

choice.prompt: Han Lie comes fiercely, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: No longer hide true strength, let Han Lie witness what true power crushing feels like, making him lose with complete admiration.
choices.visible_reward: Completely shatter Han Lie's Dao heart
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from other forces

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, the mask of a waste's cowardice already discarded. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his aura like a deep abyss awakening, a pressure far beyond Han Lie's imagination pouring out from within him. 'Han Lie, are you certain you want to be my enemy?'

choices.text: Secretly use techniques, break force with cleverness
choices.description: Do not clash head-on with Han Lie, use mechanisms, traps, concealed weapons, and poison techniques to make him fall into the abyss at his most得意的 moment.

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat but advanced, his figure ghostlike as he swept toward Han Lie's left side. From his sleeve, a poison-coated silver needle had silently射出, directly targeting Han Lie's right shoulder 'Jianjing acupoint'. 'Waste?' He coldly laughed, 'Who told you that?'

choices.description: Neither fight nor kill, use words to make Han Lie feel worthless, making him so angry he vomits blood—more painful than killing him.
choices.visible_cost: May infuriate Han Lie into berserk rampage

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head and sighed softly: 'Young Master Han, how many times have we fought? Which time wasn't this 'waste' making you come back with your tail between your legs? Today you come to deliver your face again?' His tone was nonchalant, yet every word cut deep. 'The number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect? Hmph, nothing more than this.'

Han Lie's expression turned ashen, his chest nearly exploding with rage. As a once-in-a-century genius of the Xuanwu Sect, when had he ever been so contemptuously disregarded? And by someone he had never even glanced at—a waste servant disciple! The Sky-Splitting Halberd in his hand swung violently, a black thunderbolt that tore the sky径直劈向陈机。
陈机侧身闪避，雷霆擦着他的衣袖掠过，在身后炸出一个深达数丈的巨坑。他心中secretlysurprised于韩烈cultivation的精进——这一击威力足以threateninggolden core后期cultivator。

dialogue.content: 韩烈，你这裂天戟使得倒是有几分火候。只可惜……你遇到的是我。

text.content: 遗迹深处，陈念引发的血色光芒突然冲天而起，与陈机怀中的天机录残页遥相呼应。一股玄奥的因果之力在姐弟之间流转，陈机只觉识海中的天机录suddenly清晰了三分——他甚至能看到韩烈接下来三招的轨迹！

choice.prompt: 血脉共鸣带来的短暂清晰视野，该如何使用？

choices.description: 利用预见能力找到韩烈的破绽，以最小代价一击制胜，让他输得不明不白。

text.content: 陈机不再hesitated，身形如电光火石般掠向韩烈。他的指尖凝聚出一道肉眼难辨的气劲，精准地点向韩烈右肋下的"期门穴"——那是他方才预见到的致命破绽！

choices.description: 韩烈不过是跳梁小丑，妹妹的传承才是重中之重。他要赶在韩烈之前抵达陈念身边。

text.content: 陈机头也不回，声音indifferent："韩烈，你若想死就跟着来。我现在没空理你。"他的身形已化作一道残影，朝着遗迹深处疾驰而去。"念念，哥哥来了。"
韩烈被彻底无视，只觉一股无名火直冲天灵。他堂堂玄武宗第一天才，何时被人如此轻慢过？"陈机！给我站住！"他怒吼一声，裂天戟再次挥出，黑色的雷霆如蛛网般朝陈机笼罩而去。

dialogue.content: 哥哥……是念念……念念在这里……

text.content: 血色光柱之中，一个weak却熟悉的声音传入陈机耳中。那声音带着哭腔，却又有一种难以言喻的gratified。陈机只觉心脏狠狠抽紧——他找了这么多年的妹妹，此刻就在眼前，却身处危险之中。
器灵的声音再次响起，带着一丝pressing："陈玄的传承正在与她血脉共鸣。她体内的天命锁钥正在苏醒——若被韩烈打断，轻则走火入魔，重则魂飞魄散！陈机，你必须挡住他！"
陈机abruptly止步，转身面对紧追而来的韩烈。他的眼中已无半分playful，只有一片icy的murderous。"韩烈，你千不该万不该，在她面前出现。"他的声音low如九幽寒风，"今日，你走不出这遗迹。"
